tool_input.description: Verify migration backfill on populated DB

result:
All green: `bun run typecheck` clean, `bun test` 13 pass / 0 fail, `bunx guren check` 9 passed / 0 failures (the 4 warnings about missing controller tests are pre-existing).

**Summary:** I added a stable, unique `slug` to posts and moved the public post URL onto it. `db/schema.ts` gains `slug: text('slug').notNull().unique()`, backed by a hand-adjusted table-rebuild migration (`db/migrations/20260818101854_add_post_slug/`) that backfills existing rows as `post-<id>` in the same INSERT that copies them across — verified against a populated pre-migration database — and `db/seeders/002_posts.ts` now ships explicit slugs for the sample posts. New `app/Support/slug.ts` holds `slugify()` (NFKD-strip accents, lowercase, `[^a-z0-9]+` → single `-`, trimmed, `post` fallback) and `nextAvailableSlug()`; `app/Models/Post.ts` uses them in `Post.uniqueSlug(title)` (one query for `base` plus `base-%`, then the next free `-2`/`-3` suffix) and adds `Post.findBySlug()`, with `slug` deliberately kept out of `fillable` so editing a title never moves the URL. `routes/web.ts` renames the show route's segment to `/posts/:slug`, and `PostController.show()` resolves the slug first, falls back to a numeric id lookup returning a 301 to `/posts/<slug>`, and otherwise throws `NotFoundHttpException`; `store()` derives the slug and redirects to it, `update()` redirects to the post's existing slug, and edit/update/destroy stay on their id addresses. `PostResource` now emits `slug`, and `resources/js/pages/posts/Index.tsx` plus `Home.tsx` link through it (generated manifests re-run via `bun run codegen`). New `tests/PostSlug.test.ts` covers slugify/numbering units plus the HTTP behaviour: slug page 200/404, `slug` prop on show/index/home, 301 from the legacy id, 404 for an unknown id, slug stability across a title edit, and the create redirect.
